SCSS1.label: Subscription / Sales

SCSS1.1.label: New Subscription Interest
SCSS1.1.description: Definition: The customer or institution wants to subscribe but does not yet have a subscription.

SCSS1.2.label: Pricing / Quote Request
SCSS1.2.description: Definition: The customer needs pricing or a quote.

SCSS1.3.label: Individual / Personal Subscription Query
SCSS1.3.description: Definition: An individual asks whether or how they can subscribe personally.

SCSS1.4.label: Trial Request
SCSS1.4.description: Definition: The customer asks for a trial.

SCSS1.5.label: Renewal Query
SCSS1.5.description: Definition: The customer asks about renewing or the status of a subscription.

SCSS1.6.label: Order / Agreement Processing
SCSS1.6.description: Definition: The customer asks about processing an order, agreement or contract for Scopus.

SCSS1.7.label: Unknown / Not Stated
SCSS1.7.description: Definition: The sales-related need is not stated.

SCSS1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Subscription / Sales'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Subscription / Sales' means: Definition: Pricing, quotes, trials, renewals, order/agreement processing, interest in subscribing. A trial or complimentary access that was granted but is not working is Access; a request for a trial is Subscription / Sales.
